facts.value: For each exam passed, you will receive a digital language certificate indicating your language level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), recognized by the International Office and Global Office of Goethe University.
This will be issued bilingually (German and English).
This language certificate can be used for your application abroad or later during your job search.
You can find out your grades only after receiving your certificate by email, approximately 4 to 5 weeks after the exam date.
For elective module courses and Master’s Course: You can view your grades password-protected in QIS.
